worldcombat.skill.knockoff.summary: Raise an arm and slam down: the target's held item is batted clean out of its grip and lands as an item anyone can pick back up; the blow is heavier when the target carries something. The harder you hit, the farther it flies and the longer before it can be retrieved.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.use.0: Knock the target's held item away
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.use.1: A heavy close blow against an item holder
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.use.2: Turn a strong item into something lying on the ground
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.description.0: The slam deals about %1$s Dark contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; against a target holding an item it is a further x1.5, and the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.description.1: Press in up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick, shoving the target about %3$s blocks on a hit.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.description.2: The batted item lands about %1$s blocks from the target and cannot be picked up until %2$s after landing; an item that cannot be removed stays in place and only the slam lands.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.far.on: Far toss on: the item is batted about 1.8 times as far, at the cost of a x0.92 blow and 2 ticks more recovery.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.far.off: Far toss off: the item lands about x0.55 as far for a x1.12 blow and a faster recovery, but it is easier to pick back up.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.growth.0: At level %1$s, Knock Off power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.growth.1: At level %1$s, Knock Off power rises to %2$s and the press-in to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.preference.fa: On: the item is batted about 1.8 times as far, but the blow is x0.92 and recovery is 2 ticks longer. Off: it lands about x0.55 as far for x1.12 power and a faster recovery, but is easier to pick back up.
worldcombat.skill.knockoff.preference.ai: Only presses in within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to press in. Off: it only presses in when the target is already in reach.
On: only used when the target carries a held item, as a dedicated denial. Off: empty-handed targets also take this heavy blow.
world_combat.move.knockoff.text.refused: The item held fast and would not budge
